rooms.name: Castle grounds
rooms.short: Outside the castle. A small tree stands left of centre, a tower rises on the right, and a door is set low on the left.
rooms.long: The ground in front of the castle. On the far left, a door is set in the wall. A second door sits just to its right, closer to the middle. A small tree stands left of centre, with a gap behind it. A tall tower rises at the far right.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: The game gave no look line for the room, the tree, either door, or the rope. Layout comes from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen is 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially the tree gap.

100.label: small tree, leads behind it
100.note: Engine name is ARBOLITO (Spanish, small tree). Look gives no line. Please confirm the tree really is the way through.

101.label: castle door
101.note: Left of centre, x 82 to 100. Look gave no line.

141.name: rope
141.description: A rope on the ground at the far right, below the tower.
141.note: Hotspot is not visible in the dump (visible 0) and the hero already held the rope. Look gave only filler. Description is a guess from the name and position; reviewer to confirm or drop.

173.name: far left door
173.description: A door set in the castle wall at the far left.
173.note: Not an engine exit (door 0). Look line: I CAN'T SEE ANYTHING IN PARTICULAR. The coverage report calls it a fake door. Kept as object, not exit.

179.name: tower
179.description: A tall tower at the far right of the castle.
179.note: Look line: IT'S NOT UNUSUAL. Nothing more was said, so nothing more is claimed.

rooms.name: Behind the tree
rooms.short: A small space behind the tree. A branch runs across the middle, and the way out is along the bottom of the screen.
rooms.long: The space behind the small tree outside the castle. A branch spans the middle of the scene, left of centre. A magpie perches near it, and a small key lies to the right. The way back to the castle grounds runs along the whole bottom edge.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). The magpie and key were not visible (visible 0) when surveyed, so they may appear only in some states. Reviewer: check against a screenshot.

102.label: back to the castle grounds
102.note: Engine name SALIDA (Spanish, exit). Hotspot is a thin strip along the whole bottom edge, so the player leaves by walking off the bottom. Look gave no line.

52.name: magpie
52.description: A magpie perched left of centre. The game says it looks evil-minded.
52.note: Hidden (visible 0) in the survey dump. Look line: IT LOOKS LIKE THIS MAGPIE IS EVIL-MINDED. Typed npc as it is a creature the player deals with; reviewer may prefer object.

140.name: branch
140.description: A branch across the middle of the scene, left of centre.
140.note: Look line is only filler (THERE IS NOTHING SPECIAL ABOUT IT), so nothing more is claimed.

180.name: key
180.description: A small key on the right side, above the middle.
180.note: Hidden (visible 0) in the survey dump. The game gave no look line, only filler. Description is from name and position only.

rooms.name: Entrance hall
rooms.short: The castle hall. A door on the right leads outside and a door on the far left leads further in. Two speakers stand in the middle.
rooms.long: The hall just inside the castle. A door on the far left leads further in. A speaker stands left of centre and another right of centre. A picture hangs on the back wall at the right, with a small table below it. A door at the far right leads back outside.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially what the speakers are.

103.label: door on the far right, back outside
103.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json.

104.label: door on the far left, to the corridor
104.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json. Room 24 has no name from the game, so 'corridor' is my wording; reviewer to confirm.

142.name: draskis
142.description: Something the game calls draskis, on the right near the table.
142.note: Hidden (visible 0) when surveyed. Look line is only filler. Coverage report says DRASKIS is covered or harmless, so I kept the name and made no change. Reviewer: confirm the spelling and whether to drop the textFixSuggestion.

170.name: speaker
170.description: A speaker on a stand. There are two: one left of centre and one right of centre.
170.note: Two hotspots share number 170 (rects at x 87 and x 186). Look lines are only filler, so nothing is claimed about what they do.

171.name: table
171.description: A small table at the right, below the picture.

174.name: picture
174.description: A picture on the back wall at the right.
174.note: Look line is only filler, so the subject is unknown. Reviewer: check a screenshot.

rooms.name: Tapestry corridor
rooms.short: A corridor with a wide staircase in the middle. Doors are on the far left and on the right, and a tapestry hangs by each.
rooms.long: A corridor inside the castle. A wide staircase rises in the middle. A door on the far left has a tapestry hanging beside it. A second tapestry hangs on the right, next to a door that leads back to the entrance hall.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Name and layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot.

105.label: door on the right, back to the entrance hall
105.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json.

106.label: door on the far left, to Igor's room
106.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json. 'Igor's room' comes from the coverage report, not from the game; reviewer to confirm a blind player should hear it before meeting him.

108.label: staircase in the middle, going up
108.note: Engine name ESCALERAS (Spanish, stairs). Look was silent.

151.name: tapestry
151.description: A tapestry hanging on the wall. There are two: one at the left and one at the right. The game says she has nice Transylvanian features.
151.note: Two hotspots share number 151 (x 23 and x 226). The look line speaks of 'she', so the tapestries probably show a woman; reviewer to check a screenshot. The coverage report says TAPESTRIE already has a pack fix.

rooms.name: Igor's room
rooms.short: A small bedroom with a door at the back. A shelf and drawers stand in the middle, a calendar hangs on the right, and a window is at the far right.
rooms.long: A small room inside the castle. The door back to the corridor is in the back wall, left of centre. A portrait hangs on the far left. A shelf with drawers below it stands in the middle. A calendar hangs on the wall right of centre, with a person standing below it. A window is at the far right. A book lies on the right, and a wig is at the far right, low down.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Name 'Igor's room' comes from the coverage report, not the game. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially where the book and wig sit.

107.label: door in the back wall, to the corridor
107.note: Engine name DOOR. Look was silent. Destination from meta.json. Rect x 93 to 133, left of centre.

51.name: Igor
51.description: A person standing right of centre, below the calendar.
51.note: Engine name IGOR. Look line is only filler (IT'S NOT UNUSUAL). The coverage report says the name is blank until you talk to him; I used the report's name, so a first-time player may hear it before the game gives it. Reviewer: decide whether to keep the name or use 'man'. Typed npc; reviewer may prefer object.

143.name: wig
143.description: A wig at the far right, low down.
143.note: Look line is only filler. Description is from name and position only.

163.name: calendar
163.description: A calendar on the wall, right of centre. The game says it shows Elvis.
163.note: Look line: IT'S ELVIS THE KING. YOU DIDN'T IMAGINE THAT WOULD BE HERE, DID YOU! Paraphrased to the picture only.

164.name: window
164.description: A window at the far right. It is night outside.
164.note: Look line says the night is falling and calls it scary. I kept only the night.

165.name: shelf
165.description: A shelf in the middle of the room, holding books and other small things.
165.note: Look line: A SHELF WITH BOOKS AND SOME OTHER THINGS.

167.name: drawers
167.description: A set of drawers in the middle, just below the shelf.
167.note: Look line is only filler. Description is from name and position only.

168.name: book
168.description: A book on the right. Its title is a guide to filling in tax return forms.
168.note: Look line quotes the title: HOW TO FILL IN TAX RETURN FORMS. The game calls it interesting, as a joke; left out.

169.name: portrait
169.description: A portrait on the wall at the far left.
169.note: Look line is only filler, so the subject is unknown. Reviewer: check a screenshot.

rooms.name: Upstairs landing
rooms.short: A landing with a row of doors along the back wall. A staircase goes down at the far left, and a passage leads off at the far right.
rooms.long: The upper floor of the castle. A staircase goes down at the bottom left. Along the back wall, from left to right, is a row of doors, with a large picture hanging above them in the middle. Another door stands right of centre, and a last one is high on the right. At the far right edge, a passage leads to the west wing.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Name 'Upstairs landing' is my wording (the report also says landing). Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Eight doors in all; only four are exits. Reviewer: check against a screenshot.

109.label: staircase at the far left, down to the corridor
109.note: Engine name ESCALERAS (Spanish, stairs). Look was silent. Destination from meta.json.

110.label: door in the middle, to a dark room
110.note: Look was silent. Destination from meta.json. 'Dark room' comes from the room 28 look line; reviewer to confirm a blind player should hear it.

112.label: door left of centre, to the kitchen
112.note: Look was silent. Destination from meta.json. 'Kitchen' comes from the coverage report, not the game; reviewer to confirm.

118.label: door on the right, to the torch room
118.note: Look was silent. Destination from meta.json. 'Torch room' comes from the coverage report, not the game; reviewer to confirm.

116.name: door at the far left of the row
116.description: A door at the left end of the row along the back wall. It is not a way through.
116.note: Not an engine exit (door 0 in the dump). Look line: I CAN'T SEE ANYTHING IN PARTICULAR. The coverage report lists it as an exit to room 31 (the living room), but the dump gives no destination. Reviewer: decide if this is an exit; if so it needs moving to exits.

150.name: west wing
150.description: The way to the west wing, at the far right edge. The game says that nobody knows what you will find there.
150.note: Not an engine exit (door 0). Look line: TO THE WEST WING? NO WAY! NOBODY KNOWS WHAT YOU WILL FIND THERE!! Paraphrased. Reviewer: a blind player may try to go there; confirm it is blocked.

166.name: other door
166.description: A plain door along the back wall. There are four: two left of the middle, one right of the middle and one on the far right.
166.note: Four hotspots share number 166 (x 103, 137, 184, 280). None is an exit. Look lines are only filler, so nothing is claimed about them.

175.name: picture
175.description: A large picture on the back wall, in the middle, above the doors. It shows a pale man with fangs and a toupee. The game says he is Drascula.
175.note: Look line: ...HE IS PALE, HE HAS FANGS AND WEARS A TOUPE(garbled byte)  HE SURE IS DRASCULA! The word toupee is cut off by a bad character in the dump. Reviewer: check the spelling.

rooms.name: Dark storeroom
rooms.short: A dark storeroom full of boxes, barrels, drawers and trunks. The way out is along the right edge.
rooms.long: A storeroom that is too dark to see well. Boxes, drawers, trunks and a barrel are stacked across the room, from the far left to the middle. The way out runs down the whole right edge.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line, except the game's 'this room is too dark' reply to every look. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot. The dark may clear in some game state; if so the descriptions will need variants.

111.label: the way out, along the right edge, to the landing
111.note: Engine name SALIDA (Spanish, exit). Hotspot is a tall strip along the right edge. Look gave the 'too dark' line. Destination from meta.json.

200.name: box
200.description: A box at the far left, low down.
200.note: Look was silent, unlike its neighbours. That may mean something is special about it; I claim nothing. Reviewer: check what it is.

999.name: storage clutter
999.description: Boxes, drawers, trunks and a barrel, piled across the left and middle of the room.
999.note: Eight hotspots share number 999 (3 boxes, 2 drawers, 2 trunks, 1 barrel), apart from box 200. Every look gave the 'too dark' line, so nothing more is claimed. A blind player cannot tell them apart.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.short: A kitchen. A door on the far left leads out and a door on the right leads on. An oven stands in the middle.
rooms.long: The castle kitchen. A door on the far left leads back to the landing. An oven stands in the middle, with a saucepan above it and another saucepan to its left. Drawers are right of the oven, and a bin is further right. A football team badge hangs high on the right wall, above a door that leads on to the pantry.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. 'Kitchen' comes from the coverage report, not the game. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially the saucepan positions.

113.label: door on the far left, back to the landing
113.note: Look was silent. Destination from meta.json. Rect x 31 to 66.

114.label: door on the right, to the pantry
114.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json. 'Pantry' comes from the coverage report, not the game; reviewer to confirm. Rect x 250 to 280.

152.name: oven
152.description: An oven in the middle of the room. The game says it is a shame there is no roast lamb in it.
152.note: Look line: IT'S A SHAME THERE ISN'T A ROASTED LAMB IN THERE. Paraphrased. Rect x 124 to 173.

153.name: football badge

153.note: Engine name SHIELD. Look line: THAT'S THE TRANSILVANIAN FOOTBALL TEAMS BADGE. I renamed it 'football badge' so it makes sense when read aloud; reviewer may prefer 'shield'. The game spells Transylvanian with an i; I suggest a fix, reviewer to decide.

154.name: saucepan
154.description: A saucepan. There are two: one above the oven and one left of the oven.
154.note: Two hotspots share number 154 (x 149 and x 85). Look lines are only filler, so nothing more is claimed.

155.name: bin
155.description: A small bin on the right, below the badge.
155.note: Look line is only filler. Description is from name and position only.

156.name: drawers

156.note: Look line is only filler. Description is from name and position only.

rooms.short: A small pantry. The door back to the kitchen is in the middle. A closet is on the left and a fridge on the right.
rooms.long: A small pantry off the kitchen. The door back to the kitchen is in the back wall, in the middle. A tall shelf of small things stands on the far left, with a closet to its right. A fridge stands on the right, and a still-life painting hangs on the wall above it.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. 'Pantry' comes from the coverage report, not the game. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially what the 'things' on the left are.

144.note: Look line: IT'S NOT UNUSUAL (filler). The report calls this the puzzle closet, so it may matter; I claim nothing about it. Rect x 92 to 119.

157.name: fridge
157.description: A fridge on the right side of the room.
157.note: Look line is only filler. Description is from name and position only. Rect x 219 to 260.

158.note: Look line: IT LOOKS IMPRESSIONIST TO ME... Paraphrased. Reviewer: check a screenshot for the subject.

159.name: things

159.note: Engine name THINGS. Look line is only filler, so nobody knows what they are. Rect x 46 to 86, tall. Reviewer: check a screenshot and give it a real name.

rooms.long: A small room off the landing. A door on the right leads back to the landing. A closet stands right of centre. A shelf is on the left, and a torch is fixed to the wall between the shelf and the closet. The game says the torch looks a little loose.

122.name: shelf
122.description: A shelf on the left side of the room.
